chunks: And it was said to al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad عليه السلام: “It has reached us that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:”
“Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, surely despises the meat-house and the fat meat.”

So he عليه السلام said: “We indeed eat meat and love it. Rather, what he عليه السلام meant was the house in which the flesh of people is eaten through backbiting; and by the fat meat he meant the one who struts arrogantly, proud in his manner of walking.”

key_terms.اللَّحِمِ السَّمِينِ: the fat meat; interpreted here as a metaphorical expression
key_terms.الْبَيْتَ: the house; here, a gathering-place or household setting
key_terms.الْمُتَبَخْتِرَ: the one who struts in self-admiration
key_terms.لُحُومُ النَّاسِ: the flesh of people; a metaphor for people’s honor being violated

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم mean by Allah hating “the meat-house and the fat meat”?
ai.summary: This hadith explains that the statement is not a condemnation of eating meat itself. Rather, it condemns gatherings marked by backbiting and rebukes arrogant, boastful behavior. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام clarifies the figurative meaning of the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم words in an ethical and social context.
